findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_v2_search" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "instagram" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_user_posts_by_username, get_v2_post_details_by_shortcode, get_v2_user_tagged_posts, get_v2_user_posts, get_v4_1_user_posts, get_v4_user_posts, get_v2_location_posts, get_v2_tag_posts · Public sink: get_v2_post_details_by_shortcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_user_posts_by_username, get_v2_post_details_by_shortcode, get_v2_user_tagged_posts, get_v2_user_posts, get_v4_1_user_posts, get_v4_user_posts, get_v2_location_posts, get_v2_tag_posts · Public sink: get_v2_post_details_by_shortcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
